The Crew Motorfest: Motorfest Mastery Guide – Reach Platinum in Summit with @SirFixifogaming
In this third episode of Motorfest Mastery, learn how to join the platinum rank in Summit every week with @SirFixifogaming.
Wait for the next episode to learn how to become a Grand Race legend!

Discover SirFixifo tips & tricks right here: https://www.youtube.com/@SirFixifogaming

About The Crew Motorfest:
Welcome to Motorfest! Discover the evergreen festival featuring the best experiences car culture has to offer. Complete your ultimate action driving bucket list through a series of tailor-made races, themed events, and other unique challenges. Explore the vibrant island of O’ahu in Hawaii alone or with your crew. Whatever the way you enjoy cars and driving, there is something in there for you!

The Division 2: Dust Storm Event Trailer
A sandstorm is sweeping across Lower Manhattan with dynamic weather conditions reshaping the battlefield. Play Warlords of New York for free, take on new bosses and a new Hunter, earn event rewards and Twitch Drops, and experience the return of Realism Mode. July 21-August 11.

author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
The Division 2: Dust Storm Event Trailer
Agents, a sandstorm is sweeping across New York.

Experience dynamic weather conditions that transform Lower Manhattan and reshape the battlefield. With free access to Warlords of New York throughout the event, there's never been a better time to return to the city. Plus, Realism Mode returns, offering a new way to experience Lower Manhattan during the event.

Take on powerful new bosses, challenge the new Hunter, and unlock exclusive rewards and Twitch Drops. Join the Dust Storm Event from July 21 to August 11.

About The Division 2:
Tom Clancy's The Division 2 is a shooter RPG with a thrilling campaign fully playable in co-op and multiple PVP modes.

In The Division 2, save your country in Washington, DC, and in the Warlords of New York expansion, hunt down Aaron Keener, a former Agent who has taken control of New York.
